og.foot: Share of India's finance openings by metro, 9 September 2026 · himyro.com

slides.h1: The city with the most finance jobs isn't Mumbai.
slides.caption: The city with the most finance jobs in India isn't Mumbai, and where you look decides what you'll be asked for. We read 2,067 finance, risk and compliance openings from 220+ MNC career pages.
slides.sub: Where you look decides what you'll be asked for.

slides.headline: It's Bengaluru, and it hires for finance differently.
slides.note: Share of India's 2,067 finance openings, read 9 September 2026.
slides.caption: It's Bengaluru: 24.8% of India's finance openings, which is 512 roles, against Mumbai's 21.9%.

slides.headline: There, you'll be asked for SQL and Python too.
head: Named in Bengaluru's postings
Times
slides.note: A finance job in Bengaluru is a finance job run as analytics.
slides.caption: There, you'll be asked for SQL and Python too. SQL is the most-named skill in Bengaluru's finance postings (81), ahead of financial services (80). Python is named 61 times.

slides.headline: In Mumbai, you'll be asked for classic finance skills.
head: Named in Mumbai's postings
Times
slides.caption: In Mumbai, you'll be asked for classic finance skills: financial services (91), risk management (77), regulatory compliance (71) and chartered accountant (47).

slides.headline: There, three employers hold half the roles you'd apply to.
head: Employer
Openings
slides.note: The top three post 51.7% of Mumbai's 453 openings.
slides.caption: There, three employers hold 51.7% of the roles: Axis Bank with 113, EY with 74 and Deloitte with 47. A short list of employers means a short list of applications, each one worth writing properly.

slides.headline: If you're starting out, nearly a fifth are entry level.
slides.sub: of Mumbai's finance roles, the highest share of any big metro.
slides.caption: If you're starting out, 19.3% of Mumbai's finance roles are entry level, the highest of any big metro.
